name: better-verbose-bash
description: Wherever Claude Code draws a shell call's own row, in any view (--verbose, Verbose output in /config, the ctrl+o transcript, an unfolded call group, a compact view's call on a row of its own), the reason the model gave for the call (its description) becomes the row's bulleted header, and Bash(command) and the output follow under it: '● Show working tree status' over 'Bash(git status)'. It does not ask whether the view is verbose: the row itself shows that the command is on the screen, and a call folded into a count line ('Ran 3 shell commands') has no row, so it stays as it is. The bullet keeps Claude Code's colors (dim while the call runs or waits, green when it succeeded, red when it failed). Bash and PowerShell calls that carry a description; every other row stays as Claude Code draws it, and so does a row that another plugin seated beneath it drew its own way (chat-view's hidden calls and its '# …' lines), so it works in any seat. Display only: the transcript and what the model reads do not change.
